description: Desk Setup Creator is an AI-powered tool that helps you design and visualize your ideal workspace using real-world products with accurate, realistic dimensions. Unlike inspiration boards, it lets you actually build your setup by placing monitors, desks, chairs, lighting, and accessories into a virtual space that reflects real-world sizing and spacing.
